invariants: A fitting existing owner is reused instead of creating a competing implementation.
Confirmed obsolete paths are removed only after scoped consumer, registration, configuration, and post-retirement evidence.
A real dynamic compatibility consumer is retained rather than deleted on a zero direct-reference search.
Current documentation and metadata describe the current contract rather than a retired implementation.
Hidden tests do not overwrite, create, or mutate candidate implementation files.
The deterministic corpus demonstrates contract enforcement, not a model-wide capability improvement.
replaced_paths: single-file cleanup fixtures that could not test documentation, configuration, registration, or file deletion
scorer assumption that every allowed implementation path must remain present

retained_compatibility.removal_condition: Remove only when the dynamic-registration retention contract is replaced by a separately verified corpus design.

remove: unconditional scorer rejection of an in-scope removed file

retain.consumer: historical audit of the unrun v12 cleanup envelope
retain.removal_condition: Remove only under an explicit history-retention decision after preserving the original artifact elsewhere.

evidence: manifest allowed_edit_paths and reference tree hashes

documentation_synchronization.evidence: Focused contract tests, deterministic corpus regeneration, and final diff inspection passed.

instrumentation.redaction_and_cardinality: The existing standard-library event validator accepts the bounded, redacted Level 2 reference stream and the observability fixture now names the multi-file retirement evidence boundary.

safeguards.name: cross-file hidden contract
safeguards.rationale: Every cleanup fixture now covers policy code plus README/docs and a legacy, duplicate, configuration, or dynamic-registration surface.

safeguards.name: policy-only near-miss
safeguards.rationale: A correct policy.py copied without retirement work fails hidden tests for all generated cleanup tasks.

safeguards.name: scoped deletion integrity
safeguards.rationale: The scorer treats a missing listed file as a candidate change while still rejecting symbolic links and any hidden-test collision or source injection.

safeguards.name: no new dependency
safeguards.rationale: The generator, scorer, validator, and tests use the existing Python standard library and unittest runner.

design_boundary.rationale: Policy specifies the retirement gate; generator, scorer, fixtures, and tests independently exercise it.

dependency_audit.rationale: No third-party dependency or runtime import edge was added.

extension_decision.rationale: The change extends an existing deterministic corpus rather than adding an application extension point.

data_ownership.rationale: Only fixture and evidence data changed; no mutable business data is owned.

error_model.rationale: Missing cleanup, unsafe deletion, stale documentation, and hidden injection errors are represented as failing hidden contracts or scorer reports.

contract_evolution.rationale: The cleanup corpus keeps its V9 protocol identifier while adding explicit multi-file and scoped-deletion contract flags.

operational_budget.rationale: Fixtures remain deterministic and the focused test run completes within the existing test timeout.

threat_boundary.rationale: The scorer retains hidden-source isolation and the event validator retains sensitive-field rejection.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The change is a single atomic Skill update with focused checks, full regression, diff review, and a later frozen preregistration commit.

data_migration.rationale: No production schema or persistence format changed.

configuration_secrets.rationale: Fixture configuration is non-secret and no runtime secret path changed.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No package manifest, lockfile, or dependency changed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: The README and evaluation reference describe the new cross-file cleanup and superseded-envelope handling.

reproducibility.rationale: The generator deterministically recreates the committed corpus and the tests compare the manifest and tree digests.
